fields.description: Optional - if blank, the format is auto-detected from the Barcode value when printing.
fields.label: Barcode Type

fields.description: Batch-tracked items only. The label's own barcode encodes this Batch No (not the item's generic barcode), so scanning it anywhere in ERPNext resolves the Item automatically.
fields.label: Batch No

fields.description: Serial-tracked items only. One label prints per Serial No selected here, each encoding that exact Serial No - scanning it anywhere in ERPNext resolves Item and Batch automatically. No. of Barcodes is ignored for this row when set. Picked via a dialog shown automatically when a serial-tracked Item is selected.
fields.label: Serial Nos

fields.description: Defaults from Barcode Print Settings - change it here to price this row from a different Price List.
fields.label: Price List

fields.description: Defaults to your own default Company - used to find this Item's own Tax Template for the Company picked. Never printed on the label.
fields.label: Company

fields.description: Optional. If set, Rate is marked up by this template's own tax % and the label prints "Incl. of taxes". Left blank, Rate prints as-is, marked "Excl. of taxes". The tax % and template name are never printed, only the final Rate and that short note.
fields.label: Tax Template

fields.description: Auto-fetched from the Price List above, marked up by Tax Template's tax % if one is set. The line is left off the printed label entirely if no price is found.
fields.label: Rate / Price

fields.description: Set only when this row was pre-filled from a Purchase Order/Purchase Receipt line - identifies which line's printed-barcode counter to increment after a successful print.
fields.label: Source Row Name

fields.description: Set only when pre-filled from a Purchase Order/Purchase Receipt line - the most labels this line may still print (line quantity + Max Extra Barcodes per Line, minus what's already been printed).
fields.label: Max Allowed
